<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Break,” he commanded, adding authority to his Ruler technique.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|— ''Wintersteel'', chapter 7}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Red Faith Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Red]] Faith refers to both a powerful individual and an associated sect. The [[Sage of Red Faith]] is a tall, skeletal man with knee-length white hair and red lines descending from his eyes that resemble bloody tears. He is characterized by a tendency toward intense emotion, often oscillating between rage and perceived lunacy, and has a history of failed attempts to ascend to the rank of [[Monarch]]. In combat, he utilizes [[blood madra]] and various techniques, including daggers, claws, and a [[Striker technique]] that can kill animals by flooding the area with red light. He is known for his tutelage of students and his sponsorship of specific Shadows. The entity also encompasses a group or sect, which includes the [[Sage]]'s students and a [[Herald]] known as [[Redmoon]]. The [[Herald]] serves as the brute force counterpart to the [[Sage]]'s intellectual focus, though the two are described as opposites. The sect is associated with the spreading of [[Blood Shadows]] and operates within a framework involving various other sects and [[Monarchs]]. [[Red]] Faith has expressed a desire for the perfect fusion of mind and body and has engaged in conflicts regarding [[Authority|authority]], loyalty, and the pursuit of power.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This individual possesses pure white hair and skin. Described as a cockroach walking like a man, they also have claws and [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] that resemble trails of [[blood]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a researcher, [[Red]] Faith is interested in Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius and intends to fuel her [[advancement]] through experiments. They act as the mind in their relationship with the [[Herald]] and find [[Heralds]] difficult to manage if they die without leaving a [[Remnant]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Red]] Faith is bound to [[Yerin|Yerin Arelius]] by a soul-oath{{!}}soul oath and acts as her researcher, lecturer, and mentor regarding [[blood essence]]. He is also connected to [[Eithan]], whose armor was breached by his claws. Additionally, [[Red]] Faith has spoken to [[Redmoon]] and is a member of the group known as [[Redmoon Hall]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Blood Sage]] and [[Forger]], [[Red]] Faith utilizes [[blood madra]], [[sword aura]], and nine daggers. Their techniques include [[Striker]], [[Ruler]], and [[Enforcer]] arts, as well as a [[launcher construct]] made from an ancient cauldron that releases venom and death [[aspects]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Hunt for Yerin Arelius}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Red]] Faith maintains a deep interest in Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius, acting as a group that is specifically curious about her unique methods.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> Marked by [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] that resemble trails of [[blood]], he possesses the ability to follow through space and is currently hunting for her.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" /> He intends to use [[Yerin]]'s [[advancement]] to fuel his own experiments, while serving as the mind in his relationship with the [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" /> To calm himself, he utilizes both [[aura]] and [[blood]], and his presence has been sensed within the [[Redmoon Hall]] vessel.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Member of Redmoon Hall}} ===

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Break,” he commanded, adding authority to his Ruler technique.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“That you remain here instead of hunting for Yerin Arelius, as I have done, only proves that you do not deserve the independence you stole.”<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“If you believe you are the mind in our relationship, then it should not trouble you so much to think.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“He’s using his body as a medium for the Phoenix to reach us,” Red Faith explained<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“I should never have allowed you to remain,” Red Faith shouted.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" />}}
